scope: Exact equality of the feasible projection onto original10255 variables within the audited finite source angles/inward integer domains/fixed57 construction; not unrestricted physical packing.
new_to_old: Retain base variables. For each old flag set active AND shared truth. Every old direction implication and flag<=active holds. Every active old OR has a true shared disjunct and hence a true assigned old flag. Inactive ORs hold via not active.
old_to_new: Retain base variables. Set every shared flag to the unique truth of its normalized integer inequality. Each active old OR has an old true flag implying the original plane, exactly equivalent to its normalized plane, so the new OR holds. All shared truth/complement definitions hold, including inactive modes.
normalization: For positive gcd g, lhs/g is integral. Lhs>=bound iff lhs/g>=ceil(bound/g); its exact complement is <=ceil(bound/g)-1. Boundary inequalities were checked for every occurrence.
